The monsoon, Karjat

Leave Mumbai after breakfast and you're in Karjat by lunch. Hills on three sides, paddy in the valleys, and from June to September, a waterfall on every cliff.

We've bought and sold land here for thirteen years, and we film every property before it goes on the list.

Why people buy land here

The monsoon

From June to September, streams run down every cliff and the valleys turn the green you see in the films. People drive up from the city just to watch it.

The valleys

Open farmland under the hills, with room for a farmhouse, an orchard or simply land you hold for the long term.

The water

The Ulhas runs through Karjat, with dams and lakes close by. River-touch plots are some of the first to go.
